narrative: Unsloth Studio's June build makes a long-context dense-class open model fine-tune and serve on consumer memory, extending coverage to Blackwell and B300. That reinforces the structural force the recipe relies on: dense long-context checkpoints fitting commodity VRAM and collapsing on-prem deployment cost, pulling the local-LLM default toward exactly this dense, long-context shape.
remaining_gap: The shipped target is 12B at 256K, short of the named 27B-dense and 1M-context magnitudes; no third-vendor 20-30B dense release confirms convergence.
